question: What quality characterizes the arisen Illumination of the Eye in its culminating form?
premises: The Illumination of the Eye has arisen.
It is filled with the nectar of supreme nonduality.
This quality defines its present emergence.
inference: This Illumination of the Eye has arisen, filled with the nectar of supreme nonduality.
plain_english: This Illumination of the Eye has arisen, filled with the nectar of supreme nonduality.
